reason: 2,400 EUR plus 140 a month is over 4,000 EUR in the first year, more than an eighth of what my whole firm brings in, for a site when I know people in Oradea who do one for 600-900. My clients come from cards like the ones I'm handing out today and from farmers recommending me to their neighbours, not from a contact form.
objection: With 5-15 clients a year I get maybe two or three bad requests a month; paying 140 EUR every month so a robot tells me why they're not eligible doesn't give me back real hours. The document chasing is the only part that actually hurts, and it's bundled with a website I'm not sure I need.
would_change_my_mind: Sell me the document-upload link with the automatic reminders on its own, around 500-700 EUR setup and 30-40 a month, without the website; that I'd try, because chasing attachments is where my hours really go.
